prompts.izquierda:
Animation sprite of EXACTLY the attached approved TYPELY Órbita spacecraft. Preserve vehicle identity completely: same rounded swept side pods, pearl-white hull, mint belt, low oval blue/lavender canopy with lavender ring, cyan round shoulder lights, small gold stars, central cyan-star badge, two exposed lavender/gold round rear thrusters, cyan crystal on forward nose. No people, no new details.
Change ONLY the 3D flight pose: the craft banks and steers mildly to screen LEFT, nose points toward 11 o'clock. Elevated REAR view as in the reference, flying AWAY toward the top of the frame, with the TWO rear engine apertures still clearly visible near the bottom. It is a shallow turn for an animation, about 18 degrees counterclockwise direction and a subtle 10-degree bank, revealing slightly more of one side's thickness. NOT a side-on view, NOT rotating the image as a flat sticker, NOT turning toward camera. The same camera elevation, focal length, object scale and lighting as the reference.
Fixed SQUARE canvas, same center of mass (near 50% x,54% y), all edges fit. Keep hull volume and proportions exact; do not make nose longer or engine nozzles larger. One whole ship only. Clean idle TURN sprite with restrained cyan engine-core light, no flame, smoke, beams, external particles or effects, no labels.
Transparent background with real alpha if supported. Preserve existing transparency, don't add scenery, floor or decorative background.
